# Test documents

These files contain synthetic content only. `workbook.xls` has two small worksheets; `sparse.xls` has two cells at opposite corners of an XLS worksheet and exercises the isolated reader's memory limit. `example.docx` and `example.pptx` contain simple text, tables or shapes, and an embedded image. `example.pdf` has two pages and an embedded 1800×1400 image. The XLS files were generated with SheetJS, the Office files with the `docx` and `pptxgenjs` packages, and the PDF with PDFKit.
